name: sell-cash-secured-put
description: List a cash-secured put with ETH: the Router wraps strike wei of ETH as the collateral and offers the right to sell amount of token to you for it until expiry. Only tokens with putsEnabled. Send strike as value. Returns the option id.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: Listed token address (AssetRegistry.getAsset must return listed and enabled).

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Tokens in base units (token decimals). The token must have puts enabled (get-asset.putsEnabled).

inputs.name: strike
inputs.description: Total strike for the whole amount, in wei of ETH; locked as WETH collateral and also sent as the transaction value.

inputs.name: premium
inputs.description: Premium the buyer pays, in wei of ETH. Minimum 0.0005 ETH; a 3% fee is taken from it when filled.

inputs.name: expiry
inputs.description: Unix timestamp when the option expires; 1 hour to 90 days from now (24 hours max for Pons launchpad tokens).

inputs.name: offerDeadline
inputs.description: Unix timestamp until which the offer can be bought; at most expiry.
